## Course · Curso

- **Folder · Carpeta:** `community/<lang>/<author>.<course>/`
- **What it teaches and for whom · Qué enseña y a quién:**
- **New course or update · Curso nuevo o actualización:**

## Checklist

- [ ] I wrote this course (or I have the right to publish every text and image in it) and I agree to publish it
      under the licence in `curso.yaml`; the code in `gen/` under the MIT licence.
      · He escrito este curso (o tengo derecho a publicar cada texto e imagen) y acepto publicarlo con la licencia
      de `curso.yaml`; el código de `gen/`, con la licencia MIT.
- [ ] Images that are not mine are credited in `img/_creditos.yaml`. · Las imágenes que no son mías tienen sus
      créditos en `img/_creditos.yaml`.
- [ ] I checked the facts and every official answer. · He comprobado los datos y cada respuesta oficial.
- [ ] `python kit/community.py check community/<lang>/<author>.<course>` shows no errors. · No da errores.
- [ ] I built it and tried it (`python kit/build.py --curso=…` and `python kit/preview.py …`). · Lo he compilado
      y probado.

<!-- The maintainer reviews every course by hand (content and code) before merging; only then does it appear in
